text: [3] sattimāni bhikkhave balāni . katamāni satta saddhābalaṃ viriyabalaṃ hirībalaṃ ottappabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ imāni kho bhikkhave satta balānīti . #1 ma. hoti . evamīdisesu ṭhānesupi . saddhābalaṃ viriyabalaṃ 1 hirī 2 ottappiyaṃ balaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ 3 paññā ve sattamaṃ balaṃ etehi balavā bhikkhu sukhaṃ jīvati paṇḍito yoniso vicine dhammaṃ paññāyatthaṃ vipassati pajjotasseva nibbānaṃ vimokkho hoti cetasoti .
